name: my-daily-log
title: My Daily Log
description: Log what you do every day, get reminded to log, and summarize your days with a local LLM.
author: frugoman

commands.name: dailyLogList
commands.title: My Daily Log
commands.description: List, edit and delete the logs of a day

commands.name: loggedDaysInMonthList
commands.title: Logged Days of Month
commands.description: List of all logged days, grouped by month

commands.name: searchLogs
commands.title: Search Logs
commands.description: Search through everything you have ever logged

commands.name: logReminderMenuBar
commands.title: Log Reminder
commands.subtitle: My Daily Log
commands.description: Menu bar item that reminds you to log what you are doing when you have not logged for a while

preferences.name: reminderIntervalMinutes
preferences.title: Remind Me Every
preferences.description: How long without a new log before you are reminded

preferences.name: reminderStartTime
preferences.title: Working Hours Start
preferences.description: Do not remind before this time (24h format, e.g. 09:00)

preferences.name: reminderEndTime
preferences.title: Working Hours End
preferences.description: Do not remind after this time (24h format, e.g. 18:00)

preferences.name: reminderWeekdaysOnly
preferences.title: Days
preferences.label: Only remind me on weekdays
preferences.description: Skip reminders on Saturdays and Sundays

preferences.name: reminderNotification
preferences.title: Notification
preferences.label: Show a system notification when a log is due
preferences.description: Besides highlighting the menu bar item, show a macOS notification

commands.name: daySummaryView
commands.title: Day Summary
commands.description: AI summary of a given day, generated with your own LLM (Ollama by default)

commands.name: weekSummaryView
commands.title: Summary of a Week
commands.description: AI weekly report of what you did, generated with your own LLM (Ollama by default)

commands.name: summaryOfAMonth
commands.title: Summary of a Month
commands.description: AI summary of what you did in a given month, generated with your own LLM (Ollama by default)

commands.name: dailyStandupSpeechView
commands.title: Day Standup Speech
commands.description: Creates a speech for your daily standup meeting, generated with your own LLM (Ollama by default)

preferences.name: logPath
preferences.title: Daily Log Path
preferences.description: Folder where your logs are stored. Put it in iCloud Drive or Dropbox to sync between machines.

preferences.name: aiBaseUrl
preferences.title: AI Server URL
preferences.description: Base URL of any OpenAI-compatible API. Ollama: http://localhost:11434/v1, LM Studio: http://localhost:1234/v1, OpenAI: https://api.openai.com/v1

preferences.name: aiModel
preferences.title: AI Model
preferences.description: Name of the model to use, e.g. llama3.2, qwen2.5, mistral (for Ollama run `ollama list` to see yours)

preferences.name: aiApiKey
preferences.title: AI API Key
preferences.description: Only needed for hosted providers. Leave empty for Ollama or other local servers.

preferences.name: aiInstructions
preferences.title: Extra AI Instructions
preferences.description: Optional instructions added to every prompt, e.g. 'Answer in Spanish' or 'Keep it under 5 bullet points'

preferences.name: aiThinking
preferences.title: AI Thinking
preferences.description: For reasoning models (qwen3, deepseek-r1, gpt-oss…). Disabling thinking makes answers much faster. Sent as `reasoning_effort`.

preferences.name: aiExtraParams
preferences.title: Extra Model Parameters
preferences.description: Extra parameters sent with every request, as flags (--think=false --temperature=0.2) or JSON ({"temperature": 0.2, "top_p": 0.9}).
